title: Kanye West Says, Kim Kardashian Is Withholding The Location To Daughter's Birthday Party [Update]
htmlContent:
On Saturday morning Kanye West and The Game released their new single 'Eazy' exclusively with Spotify for 24 hours. So, It will be released on Apple Music and other streaming platforms at midnight EST Sunday.

In the single, West said, "God saved me from the crash, just so I can beat Pete Davidson's ass."

Today is West's daughter Chicago West's birthday; however, according to West, he wasn't invited to Chicago's birthday party.

Wack 100 was on the Clubhouse app in the Sleepless In LA Room hosted by Rocky Rock. Sleepless in LA shared a video recorded by Kanye West sharing that the Kardashian family did not share the location of the birthday party.

"I'm just wishing my daughter a public happy birthday. I wasn't allowed to know where her party was. There's nothing legally that says these kinds of games are being played. This is the kind of thing that has really affected my health the longest. And I'm just not playing; I'm taking control of my narrative this year, and the best father," said West.

"The Ye version of a father and I'm not going to let this happen, and this is real-time with this right here. Chicago happy birthday. I love you and I'm just putting this online because I need y'all support. I have called Kim, text the nanny, I got on the phone with Tristen Thompson. He asked Khloe won't anybody give me the address for my daughter's birthday. That is going to imprint that I wasn't there for her."

He added, "I was supposed to be in Miami recording my album. My whole schedule is all based to take my kids to school me being there for them. Making sure I'm in their lives, that is the whole point of having money. They take so many fathers throughout America. They have been taking fathers out of the home purposely. So, I'm using my voice to say this ain't going to keep happening this narrative is not going to happen. There's a lot of people not in the position to have a voice people playing games. Baby momma's playing games, the grandma be playing games like this they ain't finna play these games with me."

Wack 100 shared that Kim Kardashian just dropped all the kids off at Sunday Service.

"We just watch her pull a f****** publicity stunt. I'm going to shut all this s*** down because you all not thinking when the n*** Virgil [Abloh] from Off White died. Kanye's partner, she pulls a publicity stunt and comes to stand next to Kanye," said Wack 100.

Why? Because she knows them mother**** cameras are there. So, it's cool to sit alongside him, but you still got your boyfriend. Then, when the Virgil thing happens, you go to the funeral. All the little s*** because he and Kanye were tied together through all the clothing s***, right? Now, your crazy, and I can't be around, and you can't go to the birthday party."

Wack also added that Kanye West has not fought with Kim on anything, even giving her the family house, and he decided to relocate across the street.
